text: Kairos Starter is designed for small teams validating one workflow. It includes up to 10 seats, core voice and knowledge search features, email support, and a monthly subscription. It is the recommended entry point for a focused pilot.

Kairos Growth is for teams operating several workflows. It includes up to 50 seats, analytics, shared knowledge spaces, priority support, and annual or monthly billing. Growth is the usual fit after a successful Starter pilot.

Kairos Enterprise is intended for larger deployments requiring advanced permissions, SSO, audit support, dedicated success planning, and custom usage limits. Enterprise pricing is quote-based and is normally contracted annually.

Discount policy: annual prepayment may receive a standard 10 percent discount compared with equivalent monthly billing. Larger discounts require approval from finance and should be tied to committed volume, term length, or a documented expansion plan.

Contract terms: standard agreements renew annually, with invoices due net 30 unless procurement approves different terms. Customers may request a 30-day pilot or an opt-out milestone when the success criteria are defined before kickoff.

Expansion pricing: additional seats and usage are prorated for the remainder of the current term. A customer can begin with one department and add teams later without restarting the contract, subject to the tier limits and order form.
